search_text: published ZDI-15-175 ZDI-CAN-2854 EMC AutoStart ftAgent Multiple Opcode SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2015-05-07 CVE-2015-0538 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2015-0538 10.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['EMC'] ['AutoStart'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of EMC AutoStart. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, but can be easily bypassed. The specific flaw exists within ftAgent.exe which listens on TCP port 8045, when handling numerous opcodes. The vulnerability is caused by lack of input validation before using a remotely supplied string to construct SQL queries. By sending a crafted request to a vulnerable system, a remote attacker can exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM. EMC has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
